snippet.title: Remothered: Broken Porcelain Remastered | Release Window Trailer
snippet.description:
The Ashmann Inn returns with a renewed atmosphere, and a Free Upgrade Announcement.

This remastered edition enhances the original experience with refined lighting, improved environmental clarity, and a stronger sense of presence throughout the entire game, rebuilt in Unreal Engine 5 to reinforce the psychological tension at the core of the story.

This trailer invites you back to the Ashmann Inn and the unsettling atmosphere of Remothered: Broken Porcelain Remastered.

Free Upgrade Announcement
We will introduce a Free Upgrade for players who purchased digital copies of Remothered: Broken Porcelain during the first seven days following the release of the remastered edition.
The remastered edition is coming in Q1 2027. More details on the free upgrade will be shared closer to launch.
Platforms: PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo Switch, Steam, GOG, Epic Games Store

Join the official Remothered Discord server to connect with the team and the community. All official Remothered links below.

Wishlist the remastered edition now:
🔗 https://remothered.com/wishlist-remastered
